summary:
Observed moving FS.GG.Drivers 0.98.0 to 0.114.3 in FS.GG.SDD (FS-GG/FS.GG.SDD#1156, merged as #1157).

**A pin bump is not one line.** The version in Directory.Packages.local.props is embedded into the CLI at build time, so the same change must (a) regenerate the seven committed packages.lock.json files with `dotnet restore --force-evaluate` under the pinned SDK, (b) re-pin the embedded-skill digest goldens in DriverSkillsTests, including the always-on skill set and each skill's file count, and (c) update fixtures that model a coherent scaffold, which must now carry the agent configuration and owner guidance the delivered payload declares, and the skill-body token pins that follow the package's wording. Earlier Renovate bumps (#1072, #1077, #1101) were closed because the bot's PR does none of this, so the update stays a reviewed PR.

**It exposes defects that were latent while the pack was small.** The atlas driver skill alone ships 509 files, two roots. Three things followed: effect-log lookups that re-derived effectKey per logged effect were O(n) per question, taking `doctor` over a fresh scaffold from 0.3 s to 11.7 s (fixed by building the key set once per immutable list); `upgrade` stalled with no summary when its effect set grew mid-run (see sdd/upgrade-apply-loop-stalls-when-effect-set-grows); and a pre-existing workspace could not upgrade at all until owner skills were replaced as a unit (FS-GG/FS.GG.SDD#1155).

**Staleness.** The pin had trailed its feed by 16 versions, so the atlas skill was absent from every workspace. Policy: the Drivers pin and each FS.GG.*.Skills pin may trail the feed by at most five stable versions, enforced in the release workflow's resolve-versions job by scripts/check-skills-pin-staleness.py, not as a PR gate, because the feed moves independently of a PR.

**Scope.** Measured with SDK 10.0.403. Source delivery only; no release or installed-receiver acceptance is claimed.
title: Bumping the FS.GG.Drivers pin in FS.GG.SDD also re-pins goldens and seven lockfiles, and exposes latent engine defects
